The audit trail shows a root-owned python3 process (ppid 2114, pid 2115) executing this command and then launching /bin/bash on pts0 with no auid (unset), which indicates an interactive session that was not authenticated through a normal login. This matches an attacker who has obtained a shell and is stabilizing it with pty.spawn, typically following a reverse shell or command-injection foothold. Interactive root shell spawning via inline Python is rarely legitimate in production logs.
